changed_in.5.3: Any Lua value may be attached; earlier only a table or `nil` is accepted and anything else is refused. The value also stops being optional: leaving it out now raises, where before it counted as `nil` and detached whatever was there.
changed_in.5.4: A third argument names which of the userdata's values to write, counting from `1` and defaulting to the first, and `nil` comes back in place of the userdata when there is no value at that position to write — so a write that went nowhere can be told from one that landed. Earlier a full userdata carries exactly one value, anything written after the value is ignored, and a call whose arguments are accepted has always written something.
